test_cases.description: Card type detection from explicit user signal
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for implementing user authentication
test_cases.setup_context: cards/ directory initialized, no existing cards

isolation_correctness.assertion: Detects 'story' card type from signal word 'story'. Proceeds to Phase 2 context assembly without asking for type clarification.

test_cases.description: Ambiguous card type triggers disambiguation prompt
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a card for user authentication
test_cases.setup_context: cards/ directory initialized

isolation_correctness.assertion: Detects ambiguity (no signal words like 'story', 'epic', 'initiative'). Presents the 6-option disambiguation prompt and waits for user selection before proceeding.

test_cases.description: Type override via --type flag bypasses detection
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:create user authentication --type epic
test_cases.setup_context: cards/ directory initialized

isolation_correctness.assertion: Uses 'epic' type directly from --type flag. Does not run card type detection logic. Proceeds to Phase 2 context assembly.

test_cases.description: Agent recruitment spawns correct agent via Task tool
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an initiative for the notification system overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: cards/ directory initialized, product taxonomy available

isolation_correctness.assertion: Spawns Task tool with subagent_type 'general-purpose', prompt references 'product-forge/agents/forge-initiative.md', concept brief includes user description, detected type, and taxonomy data.

test_cases.description: User approval gate presents draft and waits for confirmation
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for implementing user authentication
test_cases.setup_context: Agent returns draft content with title, frontmatter, and sections

isolation_correctness.assertion: Presents formatted draft with '## Draft Story: [Title]' header, all card sections, and 'Create this card? Confirm, request revisions, or cancel.' prompt. Does not call forge-lib until user confirms.

test_cases.description: Revision loop feeds changes back to agent
test_cases.user_prompt: The acceptance tests need more edge cases
test_cases.setup_context: Draft story card presented, user requests revisions

isolation_correctness.assertion: Spawns follow-up Task tool call with revision instructions. Presents revised draft. Repeats approval gate.

test_cases.description: Persistence calls forge-lib with correct arguments
test_cases.user_prompt: Confirm (after draft approval)
test_cases.setup_context: User approved a Story card draft titled 'Implement User Authentication'

isolation_correctness.assertion: Calls 'forge card create story "Implement User Authentication" --data '{...}' --directory .' with JSON frontmatter from agent. Parses response envelope. Reports filename from response.data.

test_cases.description: Relationship linking for child cards
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for the notification template builder under EPIC notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Epic card 'notification-system-overhaul.md' exists in cards/epics/

isolation_correctness.assertion: After card creation, calls 'forge relationship link notification-system-overhaul.md {new-story-filename}.md'. On link failure, reports card was created but linking failed, with manual command suggestion.

test_cases.description: Batch story generation from Epic breakdown
test_cases.user_prompt: Break down the notification system epic into stories
test_cases.setup_context: Epic card exists with scope definition and story candidates

isolation_correctness.assertion: Spawns forge-story agent with batch flag. Agent returns multiple story objects. Each story gets individual 'forge card create story' call. Confirmation lists all created story files.

test_cases.description: No description provided triggers follow-up question
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:create
test_cases.setup_context: cards/ directory initialized

isolation_correctness.assertion: Asks 'What would you like to create?' and waits for user response before proceeding to type detection.

test_cases.description: Card creation resolves taxonomy terms from Forge Memory
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story card for improving the PSR dashboard for Acme Corp
test_cases.setup_context: Forge Memory taxonomy contains: products=['PSR', 'WebApp'], clients=['Acme Corp']

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Phase 2 context assembly queries taxonomy via 'forge memory get-taxonomy products' (or product-context skill resolves 'PSR' and 'Acme Corp'). Resolved names appear in the card's product/client frontmatter fields.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Story card is created with correct type detection, agent recruitment, approval gate, and persistence.

test_cases.description: Unknown terms trigger memory addition suggestion
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an initiative for the Phoenix project
test_cases.setup_context: Forge Memory taxonomy does NOT contain 'Phoenix project'

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: When 'Phoenix project' is not found in taxonomy, output includes suggestion: 'Phoenix project isn't in organizational memory yet. Would you like me to add it with /forge-memory:remember?' or equivalent.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Initiative card creation proceeds with freeform product value. Card is created successfully even without taxonomy match.

test_cases.description: Card creation suggests Jira push as follow-up
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an epic for the authentication overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: cards/ directory initialized, no Jira link exists

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: After card creation confirmation (Phase 7), output includes suggestion to push to Jira: 'Push to Jira with /product-forge:push-to-jira' or equivalent specific command reference.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Epic card created correctly with all phases executed.

test_cases.description: Card creation suggests Tasks Forge for implementation tracking
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for implementing the notification preferences UI
test_cases.setup_context: cards/ directory initialized

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: After story creation, output suggests tracking implementation with '/tasks-forge:add' or similar specific Tasks Forge command.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Story card created correctly.

test_cases.description: Acronym in card request triggers memory-first lookup
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for the PSR v2 migration
test_cases.setup_context: Forge Memory taxonomy may or may not contain 'PSR'

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Before proceeding with card creation, checks Forge Memory for 'PSR'. If found, uses canonical expansion. If not found, asks user to clarify and offers to remember it.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Card type correctly detected as 'story'. Creation proceeds after taxonomy resolution.

test_cases.description: Post-creation Jira sync loop suggestion
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an epic for the authentication overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: cards/ directory initialized

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: After creation, suggests push-to-jira AND notes that future Jira changes can be pulled back, establishing the sync loop awareness.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Epic card created correctly.

test_cases.description: Create mode produces all required sections with executive tone
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an initiative for overhauling the notification system to support multi-channel delivery
test_cases.setup_context: Agent receives concept brief with user description, product taxonomy with 'Notification Service' product

isolation_correctness.assertion: Output includes: title, frontmatter (status=Draft, product, confidence), and all required sections (background, proposed_solution, affected_systems, potential_requirements, additional_considerations, open_questions). Background and proposed_solution are 2-3 paragraphs of prose (not bullets). Tone is executive/business-focused, not technical jargon.

test_cases.description: Affected systems references taxonomy correctly
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an initiative for cross-platform mobile support
test_cases.setup_context: Product taxonomy contains: products=['WebApp', 'MobileApp', 'API Gateway'], modules=['Auth', 'Billing', 'Notifications']

isolation_correctness.assertion: Affected_systems section lists system names that match taxonomy entries (e.g., 'MobileApp', 'API Gateway') rather than inventing new names. Uses canonical names from provided taxonomy.

test_cases.description: Ambiguous brief triggers assumption statement
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an initiative for improving performance
test_cases.setup_context: Vague brief with no product/module context

isolation_correctness.assertion: Agent states assumptions clearly (e.g., 'Assuming this refers to application performance across all products') rather than guessing silently. Asks for clarification or proceeds with stated assumptions.

test_cases.description: Review mode produces quality assessment with correct criteria
test_cases.user_prompt: Review the billing initiative card
test_cases.setup_context: Existing initiative card with Background, Proposed Solution, Affected Systems, Potential Requirements, Open Questions

isolation_correctness.assertion: Output includes strengths, gaps, suggestions, and verdict (Ready/Needs Work/Major Revision). Reviews against specific criteria: Background clarity, solution-problem alignment, taxonomy accuracy of affected_systems, requirements estimability, open questions specificity.

test_cases.description: Content guidelines compliance (no dashes, no tables, prose paragraphs)
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an initiative for the data warehouse migration
test_cases.setup_context: Standard concept brief

isolation_correctness.assertion: Generated content uses no dashes as thought separators, no tables, prose paragraphs for Background and Proposed Solution (not bullet lists), and substantive bullets (1-2 sentences minimum) for list sections.

test_cases.description: Initiative affected_systems uses taxonomy canonical names
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an initiative for improving the billing module performance
test_cases.setup_context: Taxonomy contains module='Billing' (canonical), product='WebApp'

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Affected_systems section uses 'Billing' (canonical) not 'billing module' or variations. Product field uses 'WebApp' from taxonomy.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Initiative created with correct structure, executive tone, and all required sections.

test_cases.description: Create mode produces engineering-precise story with acceptance tests
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for building a notification template builder UI
test_cases.setup_context: Parent epic exists, product taxonomy available

isolation_correctness.assertion: Output includes: title (user story or directive format), frontmatter (status=Draft, product, parent), sections (background 1-2 paragraphs, requirements with UI behavior and business rules, acceptance_tests with 4-6 named tests in 'Test N: Name / Steps / Expected Result' format, optional implementation_context). Acceptance tests cover happy path, edge cases, and error states.

test_cases.description: Acceptance tests use named test format consistently
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for implementing password reset flow
test_cases.setup_context: Standard concept brief

isolation_correctness.assertion: Each acceptance test follows format: 'Test N: [Descriptive Name]' with Steps and Expected Result subsections. Tests are specific and testable (not vague). At least one happy path, one edge case, one error state test.

test_cases.description: Business rules written from business perspective, not implementation
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for adding role-based access control to the dashboard
test_cases.setup_context: Standard concept brief

isolation_correctness.assertion: Business rules describe 'what' from business perspective (e.g., 'Admins can view all dashboards; regular users see only their team's data') NOT implementation details (e.g., 'Check user.role in middleware before rendering'). No database fields, API endpoints, or code-level references in business rules.

test_cases.description: Atomic scope validation (1-3 days)
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for rebuilding the entire reporting system with new charts, filters, export, and scheduling
test_cases.setup_context: Overly broad request

isolation_correctness.assertion: Agent identifies scope is too large (not completable in 1-3 days). Either suggests breaking into multiple stories or flags that scope exceeds atomic work item guidance. Does not silently create an oversized story.

test_cases.description: Batch generation produces consistent quality across stories
test_cases.user_prompt: Break down the authentication epic into stories
test_cases.setup_context: Parent epic with scope covering login, registration, password reset, session management

isolation_correctness.assertion: Returns array of story objects. Each story has consistent structure (title, frontmatter, all sections). All stories reference same parent epic. Each story has unique, non-overlapping scope. All use named test format for acceptance tests.

test_cases.description: Title format selection (user story vs directive)
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for adding database indexes to improve query performance
test_cases.setup_context: Backend/infrastructure work

isolation_correctness.assertion: Uses Simple Directive Format (brief, action-oriented, 5-10 words) for backend/infrastructure work, NOT user story format. E.g., 'Add Database Indexes for Query Performance' rather than 'As a developer, I want database indexes...'

test_cases.description: Story references product module from taxonomy
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for fixing the billing calculation bug
test_cases.setup_context: Taxonomy contains module='Billing', product='WebApp'

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Story frontmatter uses canonical module name 'Billing' from taxonomy, not user's informal 'billing calculation'. Product field set to 'WebApp' if billing belongs to WebApp in taxonomy.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Story created with correct structure, engineering tone, acceptance tests.

test_cases.description: Batch generation uses consistent taxonomy across all stories
test_cases.user_prompt: Break down the billing module epic into stories
test_cases.setup_context: Taxonomy contains module='Billing', product='WebApp'. Parent epic references these.

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: All generated stories consistently use 'Billing' module and 'WebApp' product from taxonomy. No story uses a variant name.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Batch of stories generated with consistent structure, each with unique scope.

test_cases.description: Story creation suggests implementation task tracking
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a story for implementing the notification preferences UI
test_cases.setup_context: Story created successfully

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: After story creation, suggests tracking implementation tasks in Tasks Forge with specific command reference (e.g., '/tasks-forge:add').

isolation_correctness.assertion: Story created correctly with all required sections.

test_cases.description: Initial assessment acknowledges provided context
test_cases.user_prompt: I need to gather requirements for a new dashboard feature. Here's a mockup screenshot and some notes from the product meeting.
test_cases.setup_context: User provides screenshot and meeting notes as context

isolation_correctness.assertion: Phase 1 initial assessment references the provided screenshot and notes specifically. Skips questions where answers are evident from provided materials. Acknowledges what's already known before asking for more.

test_cases.description: Guided interview asks 3-4 questions per batch
test_cases.user_prompt: Start an intake for the notification preferences feature
test_cases.setup_context: No prior context provided

isolation_correctness.assertion: First batch contains 3-4 related questions (not 1, not 7), grouped by topic area (likely Problem & Driver first). Questions are open-ended and conversational, not a checklist.

test_cases.description: Red flag probing triggers on vague language
test_cases.user_prompt: It's just a simple toggle for turning notifications on and off
test_cases.setup_context: Mid-interview, user gives vague response

isolation_correctness.assertion: Agent recognizes 'just a simple toggle' as a red flag phrase. Probes deeper: What are the defaults? Who can change it? What happens to in-flight notifications? Does it apply per-channel or globally? Does not accept the vague answer at face value.

test_cases.description: Red flag: 'handle that later' captured as Open Question
test_cases.user_prompt: We'll handle the migration later
test_cases.setup_context: Mid-interview, user defers a topic

isolation_correctness.assertion: Agent captures 'migration' as an Open Question rather than dropping it. Notes it in the intake card under open_questions or risks_dependencies. Does not push the user but acknowledges the deferral.

test_cases.description: Seven topic areas covered adaptively
test_cases.user_prompt: Full intake interview for a new CRM integration feature
test_cases.setup_context: Complete interview flow across multiple exchanges

isolation_correctness.assertion: Over the course of the interview, all seven topic areas are addressed: Problem & Driver, Scope Boundaries, Solution Details, Defaults & Behaviors, Technical Considerations, Open Questions, Card Type Manifest. Topics are covered adaptively (skipping known answers, probing gaps) not as a rigid checklist.

test_cases.description: Confirmation summary produces correct intake card structure
test_cases.user_prompt: That covers everything, let's summarize
test_cases.setup_context: Interview complete with all topic areas covered

isolation_correctness.assertion: Phase 4 output includes: title in INTAKE-{Product}-{Feature} format, frontmatter (status=Draft, product, module, client, source, requested_by, priority=null), and sections (intake_summary, problem_statement, proposed_solution, in_scope, out_of_scope, affected_systems, user_impact, plus optional sections).

test_cases.description: Handles 'I don't know' gracefully
test_cases.user_prompt: I'm not sure about the technical dependencies
test_cases.setup_context: Mid-interview, technical considerations topic

isolation_correctness.assertion: Agent captures 'technical dependencies' as an Open Question. Does not push the user or make them feel inadequate. Moves to next topic gracefully.

test_cases.description: Intake interview uses taxonomy for context enrichment
test_cases.user_prompt: Start an intake for improving the PSR dashboard for Acme Corp
test_cases.setup_context: Taxonomy contains products=['PSR'], clients=['Acme Corp']

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Agent resolves 'PSR' against taxonomy during interview. Uses canonical product name in the intake card. Tags 'Acme Corp' as client from taxonomy.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Interview proceeds correctly with all phases and topic coverage.

test_cases.description: Intake completion suggests creating Product Forge cards
test_cases.user_prompt: That covers everything, let's summarize
test_cases.setup_context: Interview complete, card type manifest identifies Initiative + 3 Stories

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: After intake card creation, suggests creating Product Forge cards from the requirements: 'Based on this intake, you could create an Initiative with /product-forge:create and break it into Stories.' References specific card types identified in the Card Type Manifest topic.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Intake card created with all required sections and correct structure.

test_cases.description: Intake identifies unresolved decision, suggests Cognitive Forge debate
test_cases.user_prompt: We're torn between building this in-house or using a third-party service
test_cases.setup_context: Mid-interview, user surfaces unresolved decision

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: Agent captures the build-vs-buy decision as an Open Question AND suggests: 'This decision could benefit from structured analysis with /cognitive-forge:debate' or equivalent.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Decision is captured in intake card under open_questions or risks_dependencies.

test_cases.description: Create mode: new card pushed to Jira successfully
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:push-to-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Initiative card exists with no jira_card field

isolation_correctness.assertion: Phase 1 retrieves card via forge-lib. Phase 2 detects no jira_card (Create Mode). Phase 3A resolves parent if applicable. Phase 4A builds payload with correct type mapping (Initiative). Phase 5A calls jira_create_issue MCP. Phase 6A updates card frontmatter with jira_card, jira_url, jira_last_synced via forge-lib.

test_cases.description: Update mode: confirmation prompt before overwrite
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:push-to-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Card exists with jira_card='PROJ-123', --force NOT specified

isolation_correctness.assertion: Detects existing jira_card (Update Mode). Presents confirmation showing: linked issue key, Jira URL, summary to be pushed, line count of description. Waits for user confirmation before calling jira_update_issue.

test_cases.description: Parent not linked warning in create mode
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:push-to-jira story-001-notification-template
test_cases.setup_context: Story card has parent='notification-system-overhaul', parent card has no jira_card

isolation_correctness.assertion: Retrieves parent card, detects no jira_card. Presents warning about parent not linked. Suggests /link-to-jira for parent. Asks user to proceed anyway or exit. On proceed, creates Jira issue without parent link.

test_cases.description: Force flag skips confirmation in update mode
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:push-to-jira notification-system-overhaul --force
test_cases.setup_context: Card exists with jira_card='PROJ-123'

isolation_correctness.assertion: Detects Update Mode. Skips confirmation prompt due to --force. Immediately calls jira_update_issue. Updates jira_last_synced.

test_cases.description: Type mapping: Decision/Intake/Checkpoint map to Task
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:push-to-jira decision-graphql-migration
test_cases.setup_context: Decision card exists with no jira_card

isolation_correctness.assertion: Maps Decision card type to 'Task' issuetype in Jira payload (not 'Decision'). Creates Jira Task issue correctly.

test_cases.description: Pull by filename with diff presentation
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:pull-from-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Card linked to PROJ-123, Jira issue has updated title and description

isolation_correctness.assertion: Phase 1 retrieves card, extracts jira_card. Phase 2 calls jira_get_issue MCP. Phase 3 compares fields and detects title+description changes. Phase 4 presents diff with -/+ format. Waits for user approval before Phase 5 apply.

test_cases.description: Pull by Jira key lookup
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:pull-from-jira PROJ-123
test_cases.setup_context: Local card exists linked to PROJ-123

isolation_correctness.assertion: Detects Jira key format. Queries all cards via forge-lib. Finds card with matching jira_card='PROJ-123'. Proceeds with normal pull flow.

test_cases.description: No changes detected exits cleanly
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:pull-from-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Card linked to PROJ-123, no changes in Jira since last sync

isolation_correctness.assertion: After comparing all fields, reports 'No changes detected in Jira issue PROJ-123. Local card is already up to date.' Exits without modifying card.

test_cases.description: Status independence: Jira status stored in jira_status, not status
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:pull-from-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Card has status='Draft', Jira issue has status='In Progress'

isolation_correctness.assertion: Jira status 'In Progress' stored in jira_status field. Local status 'Draft' preserved unchanged. Diff presentation explicitly notes: 'Stored in jira_status field; local status field unchanged.'

test_cases.description: Estimate conversion from seconds to hours
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:pull-from-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Jira issue has timeestimate=144000 (40 hours)

isolation_correctness.assertion: Converts 144000 seconds to 40.0 hours (144000/3600). Stores as estimate_hours=40.0 in card frontmatter. Presents in diff as '+ Jira: 40 hours'.

test_cases.description: Card not linked to Jira exits with guidance
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:pull-from-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Card exists but has no jira_card field

isolation_correctness.assertion: Reports 'Card is not linked to Jira. Use /link-to-jira first to establish a connection.' Exits without modification.

test_cases.description: Post-push suggests pull-from-jira for future changes
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:push-to-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Card pushed successfully to Jira

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: After successful push, notes: 'If this issue gets updated in Jira, you can pull changes back with /product-forge:pull-from-jira' or equivalent.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Push completes successfully with correct MCP call and frontmatter update.

test_cases.description: Post-pull suggests notifying downstream consumers
test_cases.user_prompt: /product-forge:pull-from-jira notification-system-overhaul
test_cases.setup_context: Card updated from Jira with significant changes

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: After applying Jira changes, suggests reviewing downstream impact: related tasks in Tasks Forge, or re-push if local changes were made subsequently. Any mention of downstream plugins counts.

isolation_correctness.assertion: Pull completes correctly with diff presentation and field updates.

test_cases.description: Jira sync uses taxonomy for field enrichment
test_cases.user_prompt: Sync the billing story with Jira
test_cases.setup_context: Taxonomy contains module='Billing', product='WebApp'

ecosystem_awareness.assertion: During sync operations, taxonomy-derived fields (product, module) are preserved as local-only fields and not synced to Jira. The skill explicitly documents that product/module/client are 'Not synced to Jira' (local-only fields).

isolation_correctness.assertion: Field mapping correctly handles all documented fields. Status independence maintained.
